fields.label: Type d'étude
fields.value: Étude comparative évaluant GPTscreenR par rapport à une approche zéro-shot de tri des sources.
fields.quote: The GPTscreenR package performs comparably to a zero-shot based approach to source screening.

fields.label: Données
fields.quote: To validate GPTscreenR’s approach, six scoping reviews were identified from the Open Science Framework (OSF; https://osf.io) where the review inclusion criteria and the results of title and abstract screening were publicly available.

fields.label: Résultats
fields.quote: GPTscreenR performed similarly to an alternative zero-shot technique, with a sensitivity of 71%, specificity of 89%, and overall accuracy of 84%.

fields.label: Limites
fields.value: Limitation due to petit nombre d'études de portée disponibles.
fields.quote: Validation of GPTscreenR was limited by a small number of scoping reviews with publicly available, high-quality data on human title and abstract screening decisions.
